sv.title: Slutstriden närmar sig – talmannen vill ha besked
sv.summary: V har fått ett ”slutbud” – men säger fortsatt nej. Tunga C-profiler och distrikt vill gå högerut – men möter hårt motstånd. På tisdag håller talman Andreas Norlén partiledarsamtal. En tredje och kanske sista statsministeromröstning rycker allt närmare.

en.title: Final battle approaches – the Speaker wants an answer
en.summary: The Left Party (V) has received a "final offer" – but still says no. Heavyweight Centre Party (C) figures and districts want to move right – but face strong opposition. On Tuesday, Speaker Andreas Norlén holds party leader talks. A third and perhaps final prime minister vote is drawing ever closer.
